title: Framer Motion + 21st.dev Animation Patterns
summary: Framer Motion animation patterns, page transitions, micro-interactions, gesture-driven UI, and 21st.dev component library integration for production-grade motion design.
instructions: Framer Motion is the standard for React animation — use it for all enter/exit, layout, gesture, and shared-element transitions.
Page transitions: wrap route content in motion.div with initial/animate/exit variants, use AnimatePresence for exit animations.
Animation principles: duration 150-300ms micro-interactions, complex transitions ≤400ms, use spring for natural feel.
Use motion components (motion.div, motion.p, etc.) instead of manual CSS transitions for declarative, composable animation.
Variants pattern: define named variant objects (hidden, visible, hover, tap) for reusable, declarative animation states.
Stagger children: use staggerChildren with variants on parent + child elements for sequenced list/ grid entrances (30-50ms apart).
Layout animations: use layout prop for smooth FLIP animations when elements change position/size automatically.
Gesture animations: whileHover, whileTap, whileFocus, whileDrag for interaction-driven motion — scale buttons to 0.95 on tap.
Enter/exit: use AnimatePresence mode='wait' or 'popLayout' for route/component transitions with exitBeforeEnter.
SVG animation: motion.path with pathLength, pathOffset for drawing animations, motion.circle for morphing.
Scroll animations: use useInView or useScroll for reveal-on-scroll, parallax, and progress-based animations.
Drag: motion.div with drag='x'|'y', dragConstraints, dragElastic for swipeable cards, pull-to-refresh, draggable modals.
Orchestration: use AnimatePresence on lists with initial={ opacity: 0, y: 20 } animate={ opacity: 1, y: 0 } exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}.
Performance: animate transform and opacity only (never width/height/top/left), use will-change: transform on animated elements.
Reduced motion: wrap animations in useReducedMotion() hook and disable/scale down accordingly.
Shared element transitions: use LayoutGroup + layoutId for hero animations between routes (similar to Flutter Hero widget).
Keyframes: use keyframes array in animate for multi-step animations (e.g. { x: [0, 100, 0], opacity: [1, 0.5, 1] }).
Spring physics: use type: 'spring' with stiffness/damping/mass for natural-feeling motion (stiffness: 300, damping: 30).
21st.dev integration: reference 21st.dev component library for production-ready React components with built-in Framer Motion animations.
Use 21st.dev's ComponentArray import pattern for dynamic component rendering with animation support.
When building landing pages: use hero animations with staggered fade-up, floating elements with y-axis keyframes, CTA pulse.
For dashboards: use layout animations for resizable panels, AnimatePresence for tab content switching, progress bar animations.
For mobile: use gesture-based navigation with drag, spring-based scroll mechanics, tap feedback with whileTap scale.
